parameters: You see your father, relaxing in the front study area, humming a tune while straightening a picture on the wall.
His attention mostly on the picture on the wall, he is oblivious to your altered skin color.
"Dad!  Hi!  I'm real sorry we've been gone for so long, but you wouldn't believe what happened coming home from school!"
Your father looks a little confused, and stares at his wristwatch.
"Goodness!  What do you mean when you say something took so long?  You and your friends are home from school right on time.
"Huh?  But we were gone longer than a day, and had to stay at that Inn-"
"Benny Zinkland knows time magic, as well as time-space enchantments, \P[1]."
"Oh yeah that's right.  Yeah, he's made custom tiny realms with his own realities before, like his first ones in junior high school general magic
where he made time go by really slow inside his custom reality and out-of-sync with normal reality.  Yeah, he would do something like that, with
"Pranks?  Your old friend Benny pranked you again?  Well, maybe he simply needs some more attention.  You haven't invited him
over in a while now, and shouldn't give up on your friends.  Perhaps you should at least call him and talk.  It sounds like he
wanted to see you again.  Maybe he doesn't know how to express himself when he wants to spend time with you, \P[1].
You could have him over this weekend."
Frustrated with how blind your father is being, you try hard to not let it show.
"Dad, it's really just a tiny bit complicated...  Well its a long story, but okay, I'll think of something..."
"Good!  We could certainly have him over this weekend, if not sooner, with your other friends."
"As usual, dinner won't be for at least a couple of hours, for your mother and myself at least, we have plenty of food already prepared,
and you four can eat as much as you want, whenever you want to, at your table, or downstairs with your video games, as always."
"Thanks.  Hey, I see you finally got the new sports car.  How'd it go?"
"Not too bad.  The salesman was a little too happy, as if he was having a lot of fun making the sale, which quite honestly worries
me somewhat.  On the other hand, the car itself seems to be what I asked for."
"Have you picked out what you would like to have, once you improve your driving skills?"
"Um, not yet.  Could we wait until I get better, then I test drive some cars?  'Cuz I've seen several cars they sell at the dealerships in town,
and I'd be happy with any of the ones I've been looking at, but I don't know how they drive, and I'd like to try them out first when I'm a better
"Sure.  We can certainly do that, yes.  That sounds quite reasonable, \P[1]."
"Well, have fun with your friends downstairs.  Like always, come up and grab food whenever any of you want to.  Oh, and try to remember
that your human friends need to sleep, and have time to do homework."
"Yes, and so do I.  We certainly don't want a repeat of what occured last Tuesday, do we?"
"Bill is in the kitchen.  As always, I'm sure he could set you up with something before you head downstairs."
Focused on something else, your father is oblivious to your altered skin color.
"Um, Dad?  Can we talk?  About Benny Zinkland?"
"We already did.  I'm sure he'd love to see you again this weekend, or soon at least."
"That and I'm also busy right now.  Go on, \P[1], go ahead and have fun with your other friends.  Your mother is working late tonight,
so she won't be home until much later."
You see Bill, one of your parents' household full-time cooks, who mostly works in the kitchen of your home but also does some other
Bill is a rather young employee at your house, and working for your family is his first job, which he started only a few years ago.
He's rather well-trained though, and he's really good at preparing darn-near anything when it comes to food.  He's already learned
your favorites and what your friends like, and if you ask him he'll introduce you to all sorts of recipes you've never heard of,
including some weird stuff whenever you want.  He's also a really nice guy who's easy to talk to.
Bill smiles as he sees you and your friends.
"\P[1] and gang!  Alright, can I get you anything?"
"Hi Bill, have you seen my Dad?"
"He should be up in front, between the front southern door and the dining room."

"Hey \P[1], what's up with the caucasian skin tone?  Experimenting?"
"Just tryin' something new.  Not sure if I like it or not."
"I think your pure white skin that I fell in love with works just fine, \P[1].  It's what I'm used to."
"Really?  Um, well this stuff wears off after a while anyways."
"Back already?  \P[1], give me some time before I have more pizza ready - It takes a while to make."
